purpose: Teach: 蠅/襪/繩/簑/襦/其/其の/舛

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが夏の蠅、つまりハエ取りに苦労された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to struggle with catching summer flies.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic voice. Gazes into middle distance. Measured pace, like turning over an old memory. Gentle settling at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、襪、つまり足袋を母上が縫って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and when your grandfather was young, your mother used to sew his tabi socks for him, didn't she?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in the voice. Slightly teasing but affectionate. Leans on the shared memory. Lilting question at the end, drawing him back to her.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが農繩、つまり縄を自ら綯われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he would twist the farm rope himself.
lines.style: Same gentle wistfulness. Eyes still turned inward. Slow, deliberate — letting each image settle. Almost as if speaking to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、雨の日に簑、つまり蓑を着てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when your grandfather was young, he used to wear a straw raincoat on rainy days, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Playful undercurrent now. Light, almost mischievous. She's matching his rhythm but with her own warmth. The 'dear' is a gentle nudge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが冬の襦袢、つまり襦を重ね着された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he would layer his winter undergarments.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens slightly. Voice quieter now, more reflective. Pauses between phrases as if handling fragile things.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、文書に「其の儀」と古風に書かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: When your grandfather was young, he used to write in such old-fashioned language on documents, didn't he?
lines.style: Soft laughter underneath. Affectionate mockery — she's ribbing him gently for his antiquated ways. Voice warm and familiar, intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「其、誠なるは家族」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to say: 'The truth that matters is family.'
lines.style: Voice shifts. Quieter, more reverent. This is the heart — the weight of it lands softly. Slower pace. Breathing through it carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、書類の舛違いを見落とさなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: When your grandfather was young, he never missed an error in documents, did he, dear?
lines.style: Closing warmth. Voice tender and close, almost conspiratorial. A final gentle affirmation of him. Fades softly on 'dear', like a farewell caress.
